method: generators: six independent claude sonnet agents, blind (ONTOLOGY.md + BRIEF.md only, no access to the skill, lexicon, scripts or earlier eval sets); expectation reviewers: three independent claude opus agents, blind (different model family from the generators), case-by-case corrections logged; bundle-quality reviewers: claude opus, blind (prompt + guidance text only). Cases were generated after the Phase 5 c1 freeze and placed here after the c2 freeze; the concept ontology is unchanged between c1 and c2.
run_policy: exactly one blind run (research/runs/heldout-v4-run1-blind.json); no case edits, no tuning against this set; results reported in full including every failed threshold
